operations.936033879aed51f57ba34c89fee7dea73c9e194f:
query SdkCommunityPost($postId: ID!) {
  communityPost(id: $postId) {
    id
    title
    content
    type
    status
    createdAt
    lastActivityAt
    editedAt
    isPinned
    isLocked
    commentCount
    viewerIsAuthor
    viewerCanComment
    viewerCanEdit
    viewerCanDelete
    viewerCanReport
    viewerHasReported
    viewerContentWithheld
    space {
      id
      name
      slug
      viewerCanPost
    }
    author {
      id
      displayName
      image
      isStaff
      viewerIsSelf
    }
    reactions {
      kind
      count
      viewerReacted
    }
    reactors(first: 1) {
      edges {
        kind
        reactedAt
        node {
          id
          displayName
          image
          isStaff
          viewerIsSelf
        }
      }
    }
    attachments {
      id
      fileName
      contentType
      sizeBytes
      scanStatus
      url
    }
  }
}
operations.21765772220d3ad8156ab16f5ab642186d70effc:
query SdkPublicCommunityEvent($organizationSlug: String!, $eventId: ID!) {
  publicCommunityEventTeaser(organizationSlug: $organizationSlug, eventId: $eventId) {
    id
    eventId
    title
    startAt
    endAt
    timezone
    accessType
    isFull
    isCancelled
    goingCount
    spaceName
    hostName
    hostNames
    locationType
    venueName
    addressLine
    city
    locationText
    description
    descriptionRich {
      html
      text
    }
    image
    recordingVideo {
      watchRevision
      source
      url
      externalUrl
      posterUrl
      duration
      captions {
        language
        label
        url
      }
    }
    recordingLanguageVersions {
      language
      kind
      video {
        watchRevision
        source
        url
        externalUrl
        posterUrl
        duration
        captions {
          language
          label
          url
        }
      }
    }
    series {
      id
      seriesId
      title
      hasUpcomingOccurrence
      recurrence {
        frequency
        interval
        weekdays
        monthlyMode
        nthWeekday
        nthOrdinal
        startDate
        startTime
        timezone
        until
        count
      }
    }
    tags {
      id
      name
      slug
      color
    }
    unlockingTiers {
      name
      slug
    }
  }
}

    locationType
    venueName
    addressLine
    city

      text
    }
    image

      frequency
      interval
      weekdays
      monthlyMode
      nthWeekday
      nthOrdinal
      startDate

operations.a741edbac196f8f4f80165f4f2cf61122848fafb:
query SdkUpcomingCommunityEventSeries($organizationSlug: String!, $from: DateTimeISO!, $to: DateTimeISO!) {
  publicCommunityEventSeriesTeaserWindow(organizationSlug: $organizationSlug, from: $from, to: $to) {
    truncated
    limit
    series {
      id
      seriesId
      title
      timezone
      locationType
      locationText
      accessType
      hasEnded
      upcomingOccurrenceCount
      spaceName
      hostName
      hostNames
      description
      descriptionRich {
        html
        text
      }
      image
      recurrence {
        frequency
        interval
        weekdays
        monthlyMode
        nthWeekday
        nthOrdinal
        startDate
        startTime
        timezone
      }
      nextOccurrence {
        id
        startAt
        endAt
        timezone
        isFull
        isCancelled
        goingCount
      }
      unlockingTiers {
        name
        slug
      }
    }
  }
}
